name: UN Sustainable Development Goals
disclaimer: Adopted by all 193 UN member states as General Assembly Resolution A/RES/70/1 (2015). These are non-binding global and national aspirations to 2030, not legally enforceable obligations on any individual state.
description: The 17 Sustainable Development Goals and their 169 targets - a shared global agenda to 2030. yen-gov surfaces the goal text next to each place's trajectory; it does not score states on-track / off-track.
